title: Fast
description: May be used twice in a round at -1 Effect each.

title: Wide
description: Affects an additional target in the same zone.

title: Burning
description: Inflicts 1 Burning per attack or defend action.

title: Freezing
description: Inflicts 1 Freezing per attack or defend action.

title: Insulating
description: Protects from 1 Freezing or 1 Burning per defend action.

title: Irritating
description: Inflicts 1 Distress per attack or defend action.

title: Penetrating
description: Ignores 1 Injury reduction / atk. or inflicts 1 Injury / def. action.

title: Fragile
description: Makes an item consumable. Discard after first use.

title: Dangerous
description: On action, +1 Effect and suffer 1 Injury.

title: Pushing
description: On action, move target to an adjacent zone.

title: Pulling
description: On action, move target to your zone.

title: Area
description: Affects all targets in the zone.
